title: Heat exchanger and extraction shaft hypothesis for the Great Pyramid

tellings.quote: For example, the heat exchanger system that goes around the King's Chamber and above the Grand Gallery, the extraction shaft connected into the Queen's Chamber, which is that shaft leading out of it.

plain: The Great Pyramid of Giza may have been a machine, with a heat exchange system wrapping around its King's Chamber and above its long sloping hall called the Grand Gallery, and a shaft leading out of its Queen's Chamber to draw something out. A researcher named Jeffrey Drum describes this on Michels's show in 2026, drawing on the work of Filippo Biondi. If true, the pyramid would be part of an ancient energy system rather than only a tomb.
